w4-tf-0.en: Strangers standing close together at a bus stop usually constitute a group in the management sense.
w4-tf-0.q: 在公交车站挨得很近站着的陌生人，通常构成管理学意义上的群体（group）。

w4-tf-1.en: In Asch's line experiment, about 75% of participants conformed to the incorrect majority at least once.
w4-tf-1.q: 在 Asch 的线段实验中，约 75% 的参与者至少有一次顺从了错误的多数人意见。

w4-tf-2.en: In Asch's experiment, 37% of all participants conformed on every critical trial.
w4-tf-2.q: 在 Asch 的实验中，所有参与者中有 37% 在每一次关键试次中都选择了从众。

w4-tf-3.en: A descriptive norm tells group members what most people actually do, while an injunctive norm tells them what most people think they should do.
w4-tf-3.q: 描述性规范（descriptive norm）告诉群体成员大多数人实际上怎么做，而指令性规范（injunctive norm）告诉他们大多数人认为应该怎么做。

w4-tf-4.en: According to the lecture, the objective (actual) norm usually drives behaviour more strongly than the perceived norm.
w4-tf-4.q: 根据课程内容，客观（实际）规范通常比感知到的规范更强烈地驱动行为。

w4-tf-5.en: Social loafing requires that individual members are personally lazy.
w4-tf-5.q: 社会惰化（social loafing）的前提是个别成员本身就很懒惰。

w4-tf-6.en: In Ringelmann's tug-of-war study, total group force increased as group size increased, even though average individual effort fell.
w4-tf-6.q: 在 Ringelmann 的拔河研究中，虽然个人平均用力下降了，但群体的总拉力随群体规模增大而增加。

w4-tf-7.en: Diversity is a property of the group as a whole, not of any single individual.
w4-tf-7.q: 多样性（diversity）是整个群体的属性，而不是任何单个个体的属性。

w4-tf-8.en: The benefits of diversity, such as greater creativity, typically appear before its costs, such as conflict.
w4-tf-8.q: 多样性的好处（如更强的创造力）通常比它的代价（如冲突）更早出现。

w4-tf-9.en: Research summarised in the lecture found that travelling abroad was associated with creativity just as strongly as living abroad.
w4-tf-9.q: 课程中总结的研究发现，出国旅行与创造力的关联和在国外生活与创造力的关联一样强。

w4-tf-10.en: High team cohesiveness always increases team productivity.
w4-tf-10.q: 高团队凝聚力（team cohesiveness）总是会提高团队生产率。

w4-tf-11.en: Every team is a group, but not every group is a team.
w4-tf-11.q: 每个团队（team）都是群体（group），但并非每个群体都是团队。

w4-tf-12.en: An idea that is highly novel but cannot be applied counts as a creative product.
w4-tf-12.q: 一个高度新颖但无法应用的想法，算作创造性成果（creative product）。

w4-tf-13.en: Team innovation, unlike team creativity, includes the implementation of novel and useful ideas.
w4-tf-13.q: 与团队创造力（team creativity）不同，团队创新（team innovation）包括把新颖且有用的想法付诸实施。

w4-tf-14.en: The lecture's main explanation for conformity in Asch's experiment is that following the group reduces the risk of being disliked or rejected.
w4-tf-14.q: 课程对 Asch 实验中从众（conformity）现象的主要解释是：跟随群体可以降低被讨厌或被排斥的风险。

w4-mcq-0.en: A lecturer announces: "Half of you submitted late last week, so I'll be flexible again." Which problem does this create?
enOptions: It weakens an injunctive norm by threatening punishment
It publicises a bad descriptive norm, signalling that lateness is normal
It causes social loafing by making contributions unidentifiable
It creates positive synergy among students
w4-mcq-0.q: 一位讲师宣布：「上周你们有一半人迟交了，所以我会再通融一次。」这会造成什么问题？
options: 它通过威胁惩罚削弱了指令性规范（injunctive norm）
它公开宣扬了一个不良的描述性规范（descriptive norm），传递出迟交很正常的信号
它使个人贡献无法识别，从而导致社会惰化（social loafing）
它在学生之间创造了正向协同效应（positive synergy）

w4-mcq-1.en: A manager opens a meeting by saying "I think Option A is clearly best — any objections?" Everyone nods. Which concept best explains the silence?
enOptions: Conformity pressure as in Asch's experiment
w4-mcq-1.q: 一位经理在会议开场时说：「我认为方案 A 显然最好——有人反对吗？」所有人都点头。哪个概念最能解释这种沉默？
options: 社会惰化（social loafing）
关于工作量的多数无知（pluralistic ignorance）
Asch 实验中那样的从众压力（conformity pressure）
正向协同效应（positive synergy）

w4-mcq-2.en: Students drink heavily on weekends because they believe most peers do so, although most peers actually drink far less. This is an example of:
w4-mcq-2.q: 学生们周末大量饮酒，因为他们认为大多数同伴都这样做，尽管大多数同伴实际上喝得少得多。这是以下哪一项的例子：
options: 指令性规范的执行（injunctive norm enforcement）
社会惰化（social loafing）
正向协同效应（positive synergy）
多数无知（pluralistic ignorance）

w4-mcq-3.en: Ten employees co-write a report with no named sections; each assumes someone else will finish it. What is the most appropriate structural fix?
enOptions: Assign named, measurable responsibilities for each section
Increase team cohesiveness through social events
Add more members to cover missing skills
Label the low contributors as lazy
w4-mcq-3.q: 十名员工共同撰写一份报告，各部分没有指定负责人；每个人都以为别人会完成它。最恰当的结构性解决办法是什么？
options: 为每个部分指定具名、可衡量的责任
通过社交活动提高团队凝聚力
增加成员以弥补缺少的技能
给贡献少的人贴上懒惰的标签

w4-mcq-4.en: A manager concludes that members of a loafing team are simply lazy people. Based on the lecture, what is the best response?
enOptions: Agree, because social loafing reflects low conscientiousness
Increase team size so lazy members are diluted
Raise cohesiveness, which always fixes effort problems
First check whether contributions are identifiable and whether members feel others are free-riding
w4-mcq-4.q: 一位经理断定，一个出现惰化现象的团队里的成员只不过是懒人。根据课程内容，最好的回应是什么？
options: 同意，因为社会惰化反映的是尽责性（conscientiousness）低
扩大团队规模，以稀释懒惰的成员
提高凝聚力，因为这总能解决努力程度的问题
先检查个人贡献是否可识别，以及成员是否觉得别人在搭便车

w4-mcq-5.en: According to the lecture, what is the recommended working range for team size?
w4-mcq-5.q: 根据课程内容，建议的团队规模范围是多少？

w4-mcq-6.en: A cross-cultural team has had frequent conflict and slow discussions during its first two months. The director wants to disband it immediately. Based on the lecture, the best advice is:
enOptions: Disband it, because diversity reduces decision quality
Replace members with more similar people to raise morale
Keep it, invest in communication and psychological safety, and allow time for benefits to emerge
Let the most senior member make all decisions to avoid conflict
w4-mcq-6.q: 一个跨文化团队在成立的头两个月里频繁发生冲突，讨论进展缓慢。主管想立即解散它。根据课程内容，最好的建议是：
options: 解散它，因为多样性会降低决策质量
换成更相似的成员以提振士气
保留它，投入精力改善沟通和心理安全（psychological safety），并给好处留出显现的时间
让资历最深的成员做所有决定以避免冲突

w4-mcq-7.en: Which statement best describes the relationship between team cohesiveness and productivity?
enOptions: Cohesion amplifies whatever norms the team already holds
Cohesion always lowers productivity because of groupthink
Cohesion has no relationship with morale
Cohesion increases productivity regardless of norms
w4-mcq-7.q: 哪种说法最能描述团队凝聚力（team cohesiveness）与生产率之间的关系？
options: 凝聚力会放大团队已有的任何规范
由于群体思维，凝聚力总会降低生产率
凝聚力与士气没有关系
无论规范如何，凝聚力都会提高生产率

w4-mcq-8.en: Members of a team get along very well, but their shared norm is "do the minimum and don't take it too seriously". What outcome is most likely?
enOptions: High productivity due to high morale
Low productivity reinforced by high cohesion
w4-mcq-8.q: 一个团队的成员相处得非常好，但他们共同的规范是「只做最低限度，别太当真」。最可能出现什么结果？
options: 士气高，因而生产率高
正向协同效应（positive synergy）
低生产率，并因高凝聚力而得到强化
社会敏感性（social sensitivity）提高

w4-mcq-9.en: In a creativity session, a senior employee talks for 40 minutes while others simply agree. Which problem is most directly illustrated?
w4-mcq-9.q: 在一次创意讨论会上，一位资深员工讲了 40 分钟，其他人只是附和。这最直接地说明了哪个问题？
options: 多数无知（pluralistic ignorance）
参与不平等降低了集体智力（collective intelligence）
多样性代价过高
缺少指令性规范（injunctive norm）

w4-mcq-10.en: A company collects 100 employee ideas but assigns no owner, budget or trial process. Over time employees stop suggesting ideas. This best illustrates:
enOptions: Creativity without innovation, leading to cynicism
Social loafing caused by large group size
A strong injunctive norm against ideas
w4-mcq-10.q: 一家公司收集了 100 条员工建议，但没有指定负责人、预算或试行流程。久而久之，员工不再提建议。这最能说明：
options: 有创造力而无创新，导致犬儒心态
有创新而无创造力
群体规模过大导致的社会惰化
反对提想法的强指令性规范

w4-mcq-11.en: Which of the following is NOT one of the four team norms worth establishing according to the lecture?
w4-mcq-11.q: 根据课程内容，以下哪一项不属于值得建立的四种团队规范之一？
options: 心理安全（psychological safety）
情绪表达（emotional expression）
社会敏感性（social sensitivity）
严格的等级制度（strict hierarchy）

w4-mcq-12.en: What distinguishes a team from a group in the lecture?
enOptions: A team must have more than six members
A team has explicit goals, defined roles, explicit rules and coordination
A team's members must like one another
w4-mcq-12.q: 在课程中，团队（team）与群体（group）的区别是什么？
options: 团队必须有六名以上成员
团队有明确的目标、界定的角色、明确的规则和协调
团队成员必须彼此喜欢
团队没有冲突

w4-mcq-13.en: A remote team rarely interacts informally, and members feel less attached to the team. Which source of cohesiveness is weakest?
w4-mcq-13.q: 一个远程团队很少进行非正式互动，成员对团队的归属感较弱。哪一个凝聚力来源最薄弱？
options: 共同目标（shared goals）
平等参与（equal participation）
团队互动（team interaction）
换位思考（perspective taking）

w4-mcq-14.en: Participants primed to imagine living abroad solved more Remote Association Task items than other groups. What mechanism did the lecture use to explain this?
enOptions: Social loafing among the control group
w4-mcq-14.q: 被启动去想象在国外生活的参与者，比其他组解出了更多远距联想测验（Remote Association Task）题目。课程用什么机制来解释这一点？
options: 适应另一种文化的规范
控制组中的社会惰化
更高的尽责性（conscientiousness）
顺从实验者

w4-mcq-15.en: Team B has two members debating while the other three watch. Compared with Team C, where members take roughly equal turns, Team B is likely to:
enOptions: Outperform Team C because debate deepens elaboration
Perform equally, since information is still shared
Draw on fewer members' information and perform worse than Team C
Suffer from too much psychological safety
w4-mcq-15.q: B 队有两名成员在辩论，另外三人旁观。与成员大致轮流平等发言的 C 队相比，B 队很可能：
options: 表现优于 C 队，因为辩论加深了深入加工（elaboration）
表现相同，因为信息仍然得到了分享
利用到的成员信息更少，表现不如 C 队
心理安全过高而受害

w4-mcq-16.en: Which sequence best reflects the creativity process chain described in the lecture?
enOptions: Implementation → Combination → Information sharing → Psychological safety
Psychological safety → Information sharing → Elaboration → Combination → Creative idea → Implementation path
w4-mcq-16.q: 哪个顺序最能反映课程中描述的创造力过程链？
options: 实施 → 组合 → 信息分享 → 心理安全
心理安全 → 信息分享 → 深入加工 → 组合 → 创意 → 实施路径
凝聚力 → 从众 → 创意 → 实施
多样性 → 冲突 → 解散 → 创新

w4-essay-0.en: Case: Mei leads a new 11-person product team drawn from five countries. In meetings, Mei usually opens by stating her preferred solution and then asks for comments; most members nod. Two months in, the team reports frequent misunderstandings and slow progress, and several members privately say that others are "not pulling their weight" on the shared report, which has no named sections. Senior management is considering disbanding the team. Using concepts from Week 4, diagnose the problems and recommend what Mei should do.
w4-essay-0.q: 案例：Mei 领导一个新组建的 11 人产品团队，成员来自五个国家。开会时，Mei 通常先说出自己偏好的方案，然后征求意见；大多数成员都点头。两个月后，团队反映经常出现误解、进展缓慢，还有几名成员私下抱怨，在那份没有分部分指定负责人的共同报告上，其他人「没有尽到自己那份力」。高层管理者正在考虑解散这个团队。请运用第 4 周的概念诊断问题，并建议 Mei 应该怎么做。

w4-essay-1.en: Case: A design agency's staff are very close friends who socialise every weekend. Their informal motto is "good enough is good enough". Client satisfaction is falling. Meanwhile, the CEO launched an "ideas wall" that has gathered 80 suggestions, but none has been tested, and staff now joke that the wall is "where ideas go to die". Using Week 4 concepts, explain what is going wrong and how the CEO should respond.
w4-essay-1.q: 案例：一家设计公司的员工是非常亲密的朋友，每个周末都一起社交。他们的非正式座右铭是「差不多就行」。客户满意度正在下降。与此同时，CEO 推出了一面「创意墙」，已收集到 80 条建议，但没有一条经过测试，员工现在开玩笑说这面墙是「创意的坟墓」。请运用第 4 周的概念解释问题出在哪里，以及 CEO 应如何应对。

w04-p01-0.en: A product team includes an engineer, a lawyer and a marketer, so together they know things no single member could know alone. Which advantage of teams does this illustrate?
w04-p01-0.q: 一个产品团队里有一名工程师、一名律师和一名营销人员，因此他们合在一起掌握了任何单个成员都无法独自掌握的知识。这说明了团队的哪项优势？
options: 更大的信息池（a larger pool of information）
相互学习（learning from each other）
相互制衡、检查错误（balancing and checking errors）
正向协同效应（positive synergy）

w04-p01-1.en: A junior analyst gradually picks up data-cleaning skills from a senior colleague simply by working on the same project. Which advantage of teams is this?
w04-p01-1.q: 一名初级分析师仅仅因为与一位资深同事做同一个项目，就逐渐学会了数据清洗技能。这是团队的哪项优势？
options: 更大的信息池（a larger pool of information）
相互学习（learning from each other）
相互制衡、检查错误（balancing and checking errors）
社会惰化（social loafing）

w04-p01-2.en: Wuchty, Jones and Uzzi (2007) found that team-authored papers and patents have gradually replaced solo work across almost all fields and receive more citations.
w04-p01-2.q: Wuchty、Jones 和 Uzzi（2007）发现，在几乎所有领域，团队合著的论文和专利已逐渐取代个人独立完成的成果，并获得更多引用。

w04-p01-3.en: After reading the Wuchty et al. (2007) evidence, a manager concludes that every task in her department should from now on be done by a team. What is wrong with this conclusion?
enOptions: The evidence shows a long-term trend, not that teams always beat individuals; teams can still lose to process problems
The evidence applies only to patents, not to papers
The evidence only holds for teams of exactly 3–6 members
Nothing is wrong; the evidence proves teams are always superior
w04-p01-3.q: 读了 Wuchty 等人（2007）的证据后，一位经理断定她部门今后的每项任务都应由团队完成。这个结论错在哪里？
options: 证据显示的是长期趋势，而不是团队总能胜过个人；团队仍可能因过程问题而失败
证据只适用于专利，不适用于论文
证据只对恰好 3–6 人的团队成立
没有错；证据证明团队总是更优

w04-p02-0.en: Passengers waiting at the same bus stop form a group in the management sense because they are standing close to one another.
w04-p02-0.q: 在同一个公交车站等车的乘客构成管理学意义上的群体（group），因为他们站得彼此很近。

w04-p02-1.en: Which of the following best fits the lecture's definition of a group?
enOptions: Fans watching the same football match in their own homes
Five nurses on a ward who coordinate care for the same patients
Commuters sitting in the same train carriage
Everyone who bought the same laptop model this year
w04-p02-1.q: 以下哪一项最符合课程对群体（group）的定义？
options: 各自在家观看同一场足球比赛的球迷
病房里为同一批病人协调护理的五名护士
坐在同一节火车车厢里的通勤者
今年购买了同一型号笔记本电脑的所有人

w04-p02-2.en: A new manager asks what determines how well a group performs. According to the lecture, which three group attributes explain performance?
w04-p02-2.q: 一位新经理问是什么决定了群体的表现。根据课程内容，哪三个群体属性可以解释表现？
options: 规范、规模和构成（norms, size and composition）
凝聚力、从众和创造力（cohesion, conformity and creativity）
目标、角色和规则（goals, roles and rules）
互动、相互依赖和共同目标（interaction, interdependence and shared objectives）

w04-p02-3.en: Students in a class can constitute a group because they interact around a shared learning goal and depend on one another in discussion.
w04-p02-3.q: 一个班级的学生可以构成一个群体，因为他们围绕共同的学习目标互动，并在讨论中相互依赖。

w04-p03-0.en: Social norms are shared standards of acceptable behaviour that are usually written into formal policies and enforced through financial penalties.
w04-p03-0.q: 社会规范（social norms）是关于可接受行为的共同标准，通常写进正式政策，并通过经济处罚来执行。

w04-p03-1.en: In a design studio nobody has ever written it down, but everyone knows you do not leave before the lead designer does. Those who leave early are quietly left out of lunch invitations. Which concept best describes this?
enOptions: A social norm enforced by social consequences
w04-p03-1.q: 在一家设计工作室里，从来没有人把它写下来，但大家都知道不能比首席设计师先走。早走的人会被悄悄排除在午饭邀约之外。哪个概念最能描述这种情况？
options: 正式规则（a formal rule）
通过社会后果来执行的社会规范（social norm）
社会惰化（social loafing）
正向协同效应（positive synergy）

w04-p03-2.en: A company's wall poster says 'We value honesty', yet employees who raise problems are laughed at while those who stay quiet get promoted. According to the lecture, what will employees actually follow?
enOptions: The behaviour that is actually rewarded, tolerated or mocked
w04-p03-2.q: 一家公司的墙上海报写着「我们重视诚实」，可提出问题的员工会被嘲笑，保持沉默的人却得到提拔。根据课程内容，员工实际上会遵循什么？
options: 海报上的价值观
实际受到奖励、被容忍或被嘲笑的行为
人力资源手册
最新入职的员工怎么做就怎么做

w04-p03-3.en: Which of the following would the lecture classify as a rule or policy rather than a social norm?
enOptions: Colleagues frown when someone talks over the manager
Team members expect each other to answer emails within a day
The employee handbook states that overtime must be approved in writing
New hires quickly learn not to question senior staff in meetings
w04-p03-3.q: 以下哪一项会被课程归类为规则或政策，而不是社会规范？
options: 有人打断经理说话时，同事们会皱眉
团队成员期望彼此在一天内回复邮件
员工手册规定加班必须经书面批准
新员工很快学会在会议上不质疑资深员工

w04-p04-0.en: In Asch's line experiment, about 37% of the critical responses followed the clearly wrong majority.
w04-p04-0.q: 在 Asch 的线段实验中，约 37% 的关键回答跟随了明显错误的多数人意见。

w04-p04-1.en: A manager opens a meeting with 'I think we should go with Supplier B. Any objections?' Nobody speaks. Based on Asch's findings, what should the manager conclude?
enOptions: Everyone genuinely agrees with Supplier B
Silence may reflect conformity pressure rather than agreement
Supplier B must be the best option
w04-p04-1.q: 一位经理在会议开场时说：「我认为我们应该选供应商 B。有人反对吗？」没有人说话。根据 Asch 的发现，经理应得出什么结论？
options: 每个人都真心同意选供应商 B
沉默可能反映的是从众压力，而不是赞同
团队缺乏凝聚力
供应商 B 一定是最佳选择

w04-p04-2.en: Based on the Asch effect, which meeting practice best protects members' independent judgement?
enOptions: The manager states her view first to save time
Collect members' views independently before the meeting and have the leader speak last
Ask the most senior member to summarise first
Decide quickly by a public show of hands
w04-p04-2.q: 根据 Asch 效应，哪种会议做法最能保护成员的独立判断？
options: 经理先表明自己的观点以节省时间
在会前独立收集成员的意见，并让领导者最后发言
请资历最深的成员先做总结
公开举手快速表决

w04-p04-3.en: Asch found that 75% of participants conformed on every critical trial, so individual judgement almost never survives group pressure.
w04-p04-3.q: Asch 发现 75% 的参与者在每一次关键试次中都选择了从众，所以个人判断在群体压力下几乎从来无法坚持。

w04-p04-4.en: According to the lecture, why did participants in Asch's study go along with an obviously wrong majority?
enOptions: They came to believe the majority was correct
Following the group reduces the risk of being disliked or rejected
The line task was too difficult to judge alone
They were paid extra for agreeing
w04-p04-4.q: 根据课程内容，Asch 研究中的参与者为什么会附和一个明显错误的多数人意见？
options: 他们开始相信多数人是对的
跟随群体可以降低被讨厌或被排斥的风险
线段任务太难，无法独自判断
他们因表示同意而得到额外报酬

w04-p05-0.en: 'Most people in this office eat lunch at their desks.' Which type of norm does this statement describe?
w04-p05-0.q: 「这个办公室的大多数人都在工位上吃午饭。」这句话描述的是哪种规范？
options: 指令性规范（injunctive norm）
描述性规范（descriptive norm）
正式规则（formal rule）
正向协同效应（positive synergy）

w04-p05-1.en: 'Around here, you should never criticise your manager in front of clients.' Which type of norm is this?
w04-p05-1.q: 「在这里，你绝不应该当着客户的面批评你的经理。」这是哪种规范？
options: 描述性规范（descriptive norm）
感知规范（perceived norm）
指令性规范（injunctive norm）
社会惰化的规则（a rule of social loafing）

w04-p05-2.en: A descriptive norm tells group members what is approved or disapproved, while an injunctive norm tells them what most people actually do.
w04-p05-2.q: 描述性规范（descriptive norm）告诉群体成员什么是被认可或不被认可的，而指令性规范（injunctive norm）告诉他们大多数人实际上怎么做。

w04-p05-3.en: A new employee joins a company and is unsure how to behave. According to the lecture, which kind of norm is especially powerful in new and uncertain situations?
w04-p05-3.q: 一名新员工加入公司，不确定该如何表现。根据课程内容，哪种规范在新的、不确定的情境中特别有影响力？
options: 指令性规范（injunctive norms）
描述性规范（descriptive norms）
正式政策（formal policies）
团队凝聚力（team cohesiveness）

w04-p06-0.en: Employees at a firm each believe their colleagues want everyone to work long hours, so everyone stays late. Privately, almost all of them would prefer to leave on time. This situation is best described as:
enOptions: An injunctive norm working as intended
w04-p06-0.q: 一家公司的员工每个人都以为同事们希望大家都长时间工作，所以人人都加班到很晚。私下里，几乎所有人都更愿意按时下班。这种情况最恰当的描述是：
options: 社会惰化（social loafing）
多数无知（pluralistic ignorance）
按预期发挥作用的指令性规范（injunctive norm）
正向协同效应（positive synergy）

w04-p06-1.en: According to the lecture, behaviour is driven more strongly by the actual (objective) norm than by the perceived (subjective) norm.
w04-p06-1.q: 根据课程内容，实际（客观）规范比感知到的（主观）规范更强烈地驱动行为。

w04-p06-2.en: A team leader announces: 'Most of you have been skipping the daily check-in, so let's not worry about it any more.' What problem does this create?
enOptions: It publicises a bad descriptive norm, teaching members that skipping is normal
It strengthens the injunctive norm by threatening punishment
It causes social loafing by increasing team size
It raises psychological safety too far
w04-p06-2.q: 一位团队负责人宣布：「你们大多数人一直没参加每日例会签到，那我们以后就别管它了。」这会造成什么问题？
options: 它公开宣扬了一个不良的描述性规范（descriptive norm），让成员认为缺席很正常
它通过威胁惩罚强化了指令性规范（injunctive norm）
它通过扩大团队规模导致社会惰化（social loafing）
它把心理安全（psychological safety）提得过高

w04-p06-3.en: A manager suspects that what her team actually does and what members believe the team expects have drifted apart. Which action does the lecture recommend?
enOptions: Increase the team size to dilute the problem
Ask members what they think the team expects and correct mistaken beliefs directly
Replace the members who hold mistaken beliefs
Wait for a correct norm to emerge on its own
w04-p06-3.q: 一位经理怀疑，她的团队实际上的做法与成员认为团队期望的做法之间已经出现了偏离。课程建议采取什么行动？
options: 扩大团队规模以稀释问题
询问成员认为团队期望什么，并直接纠正错误的看法
撤换持有错误看法的成员
等待正确的规范自己形成

w04-p07-0.en: In Ringelmann's tug-of-war study, adding more people to the rope reduced the group's total pulling force.
w04-p07-0.q: 在 Ringelmann 的拔河研究中，往绳子上增加更多人会降低群体的总拉力。

w04-p07-1.en: Eight students share one grade for a group report with no named sections, and each contributes less than they would alone. Which cause of social loafing is most directly at work?
enOptions: Contributions cannot be identified, so responsibility is diluted
Too much diversity in the group
w04-p07-1.q: 八名学生的小组报告共用一个分数，各部分没有指定负责人，每个人的投入都比独自完成时少。最直接起作用的是社会惰化（social loafing）的哪个原因？
options: 团队凝聚力低
个人贡献无法识别，因此责任被稀释
群体中的多样性过多
反对努力的指令性规范

w04-p07-2.en: Mei notices that two teammates are free-riding and reduces her own effort because it feels unfair to keep carrying them. Which cause of social loafing does this illustrate?
w04-p07-2.q: Mei 注意到两名队友在搭便车，于是减少了自己的投入，因为一直替他们扛着让她觉得不公平。这说明了社会惰化（social loafing）的哪个原因？
options: 恢复公平（equity restoration）
贡献无法衡量（unmeasurable contribution）
多数无知（pluralistic ignorance）
顺从一致的多数人（conformity to a unanimous majority）

w04-p07-3.en: A manager wants to reduce social loafing in a project team. Which action is most consistent with the lecture?
enOptions: Assign named, measurable responsibilities so each person's input is visible
Add more members so the work is spread thinner
Organise a social event to raise morale
w04-p07-3.q: 一位经理想减少项目团队中的社会惰化（social loafing）。哪种做法最符合课程内容？
options: 叫成员更努力一些
分配具名、可衡量的责任，让每个人的投入都看得见
增加成员，使工作分摊得更薄
组织社交活动提振士气

w04-p07-4.en: Because social loafing has structural causes, a manager should check whether contributions are identifiable before labelling team members as lazy.
w04-p07-4.q: 由于社会惰化（social loafing）有结构性原因，经理在给团队成员贴上懒惰的标签之前，应先检查个人贡献是否可识别。

w04-p08-0.en: A manager is forming a team to design a new customer service. According to the lecture, how many members should she aim for?
w04-p08-0.q: 一位经理正在组建团队来设计一项新的客户服务。根据课程内容，她应该以多少名成员为目标？
options: 10 人以上

w04-p08-1.en: A project team grows from five to twelve members. Over the following months, members report slower communication, unclear responsibility and less personal effort. What best explains this?
enOptions: The costs of diversity arriving early
The group has become too large: coordination paths multiply and individual effort falls
w04-p08-1.q: 一个项目团队从五人扩大到十二人。在接下来的几个月里，成员们反映沟通变慢、责任不清、个人投入减少。最好的解释是什么？
options: 多样性的代价提前到来
群体变得太大：协调路径成倍增加，个人投入下降
指令性规范薄弱
缺乏团队创造力

w04-p08-2.en: Amazon's two-pizza rule expresses the same principle as the lecture's recommended team size: if two pizzas cannot feed the team, it is probably too large.
w04-p08-2.q: 亚马逊（Amazon）的「两个披萨原则」（two-pizza rule）与课程建议的团队规模体现的是同一原则：如果两个披萨不够团队吃，团队很可能就太大了。

w04-p08-3.en: Which group attribute can a manager set directly before the work even begins?
w04-p08-3.q: 哪个群体属性是经理在工作开始之前就可以直接设定的？
options: 团队凝聚力（team cohesiveness）
感知规范（perceived norms）
规模（size）
创造力（creativity）

w04-p09-0.en: A single employee with a varied background can be described as 'highly diverse' in the lecture's sense of the term.
w04-p09-0.q: 按照课程对这个词的用法，一位背景多元的员工个人可以被描述为「高度多样化」。

w04-p09-1.en: A newly formed cross-functional team has argued constantly during its first month and takes longer than other teams to reach decisions. According to the lecture, what should the manager expect?
enOptions: These are the early costs of diversity; gains in creativity and decision quality usually come later
The team will never perform well and should be disbanded
Diversity has reduced the team's pool of information
The team needs more similar members to recover
w04-p09-1.q: 一个新组建的跨职能团队在第一个月里不断争论，达成决策所需的时间也比其他团队长。根据课程内容，经理应该预期什么？
options: 这些是多样性的早期代价；创造力和决策质量方面的收益通常稍后才会出现
这个团队永远不会表现好，应该解散
多样性缩小了团队的信息池
团队需要更多相似的成员才能恢复

w04-p09-2.en: On which kind of task does the lecture say diverse groups are most likely to make better decisions than homogeneous groups?
enOptions: Tasks where speed matters above all
Tasks with one obvious correct answer
w04-p09-2.q: 课程指出，多样化群体在哪类任务上最有可能比同质群体做出更好的决策？
options: 常规、重复性的任务
复杂、新颖的问题
速度压倒一切的任务
只有一个明显正确答案的任务

w04-p09-3.en: A diverse team holds plenty of information, but members rarely discuss it and avoid questioning one another. Why might its creativity still be low?
enOptions: More information automatically improves performance, so creativity must be high
Diversity only pays off when differences are expressed, understood, challenged and combined in discussion
The team is too small to be creative
w04-p09-3.q: 一个多样化的团队掌握大量信息，但成员很少讨论这些信息，也避免相互质疑。为什么它的创造力可能仍然很低？
options: 信息越多绩效自然越好，所以创造力一定很高
只有当差异在讨论中被表达、理解、质疑和组合时，多样性才会带来回报
团队规模太小，无法有创造力
多样性会永久降低士气

w04-p10-0.en: According to the research summarised in the lecture, travelling abroad is linked to creativity just as strongly as living abroad.
w04-p10-0.q: 根据课程中总结的研究，出国旅行与创造力的关联和在国外生活与创造力的关联一样强。

w04-p10-1.en: Participants were asked to imagine a day living abroad, a day travelling abroad, a day in their hometown, or to recall their last supermarket trip, then solved Remote Association Task items. Which group solved the most?
w04-p10-1.q: 参与者被要求想象在国外生活的一天、出国旅行的一天、在家乡的一天，或回忆上一次去超市的经历，然后解答远距联想测验（Remote Association Task）题目。哪一组解出的最多？
options: 出国旅行组
家乡组
在国外生活组
超市对照组

w04-p10-2.en: Why does the lecture say that living abroad, but not travelling abroad, is associated with creativity?
enOptions: Travel is too short to meet many people
Living abroad requires adapting to and operating within another culture's norms, whereas travellers remain outside observers
w04-p10-2.q: 课程为什么说与创造力相关的是在国外生活，而不是出国旅行？
options: 旅行时间太短，见不到很多人
在国外生活需要适应并在另一种文化的规范中行事，而旅行者始终是局外的观察者
在国外生活会提高尽责性
旅行者花钱更少

w04-p10-3.en: The lecture connects multicultural experience to which Big Five dimension, the one it describes as closest to creativity?
w04-p10-3.q: 课程把多元文化经历与大五人格（Big Five）中的哪个维度联系起来——即被描述为与创造力最接近的那个维度？
options: 尽责性（conscientiousness）
宜人性（agreeableness）
经验开放性（openness to experience）
情绪稳定性（emotional stability）

w04-p11-0.en: Every team is a group, but not every group is a team.
w04-p11-0.q: 每个团队（team）都是群体（group），但并非每个群体都是团队。

w04-p11-1.en: Five analysts share a goal, but each assumes someone else owns the data cleaning, and their tasks run in parallel until they are stitched together at the last minute. According to the lecture, what is needed to turn this group into a team?
enOptions: Make goals, roles, rules and task coordination explicit
Reduce the diversity of the group
w04-p11-1.q: 五名分析师有共同的目标，但每个人都以为数据清洗归别人负责，他们的任务各自并行，直到最后一刻才拼凑到一起。根据课程内容，要把这个群体变成团队需要什么？
options: 招聘更多分析师
把目标、角色、规则和任务协调明确下来
增加成员之间的个人好感
降低群体的多样性

w04-p11-2.en: A four-person team produces a solution that none of them could have reached alone, because they combined complementary information and checked each other's work. Which concept does this illustrate?
w04-p11-2.q: 一个四人团队拿出了一个他们任何人都无法独自得出的方案，因为他们组合了互补的信息并检查了彼此的工作。这说明了哪个概念？
options: 社会惰化（social loafing）
正向协同效应（positive synergy）
多数无知（pluralistic ignorance）
从众（conformity）

w04-p11-3.en: Which of the following is NOT one of the features that, according to the lecture, distinguishes a team from a group?
w04-p11-3.q: 根据课程内容，以下哪一项不属于区分团队与群体的特征？
options: 明确的目标
界定的角色
成员必须彼此喜欢
明确的规则

w04-p12-0.en: High team cohesiveness always increases team productivity.
w04-p12-0.q: 高团队凝聚力（team cohesiveness）总是会提高团队生产率。

w04-p12-1.en: Members of a sales team are close friends, and their shared norm is 'hit the target early, then help whoever is behind'. What does the lecture predict?
enOptions: Low productivity, because friends distract each other
High productivity, because cohesion amplifies a high-performance norm
No effect, because cohesion only affects morale
Social loafing, because responsibility is shared
w04-p12-1.q: 一个销售团队的成员是亲密的朋友，他们共同的规范是「早点完成指标，然后帮助落后的人」。课程会作何预测？
options: 生产率低，因为朋友之间会互相分心
生产率高，因为凝聚力放大了高绩效规范
没有影响，因为凝聚力只影响士气
社会惰化，因为责任是共担的

w04-p12-2.en: In a team meeting, members feel able to say 'I don't understand' or 'I might be wrong' without fear of humiliation. Which team norm is this?
w04-p12-2.q: 在团队会议上，成员们觉得可以说「我不明白」或「我可能错了」，而不必担心受辱。这是哪种团队规范？
options: 情绪表达（emotional expression）
社会敏感性（social sensitivity）
心理安全（psychological safety）
平等参与（equal participation）

w04-p12-3.en: A team leader keeps noticing who gets interrupted and who looks uneasy, and pauses the discussion to clarify when needed. Which team norm is she practising?
w04-p12-3.q: 一位团队负责人一直留意谁被打断、谁看起来不自在，并在需要时暂停讨论加以澄清。她在践行哪种团队规范？
options: 社会敏感性（social sensitivity）
心理安全（psychological safety）
平等参与（equal participation）
正向协同效应（positive synergy）

w04-p12-4.en: Why does the lecture place psychological safety first among the four team norms?
enOptions: Because it is the easiest norm to measure
Because half-formed ideas are the most fragile: members who cannot admit mistakes will not share immature ideas for joint processing
Because it replaces the need for equal participation
w04-p12-4.q: 课程为什么把心理安全（psychological safety）放在四种团队规范的首位？
options: 因为它是最容易衡量的规范
因为不成熟的想法最脆弱：不能承认错误的成员不会拿出不成熟的想法供大家共同加工
因为它能保证高凝聚力
因为它取代了对平等参与的需要

w04-p13-0.en: An idea that is practical and feasible but has nothing new about it counts as a creative product.
w04-p13-0.q: 一个实用可行但毫无新意的想法，算作创造性成果（creative product）。

w04-p13-1.en: A team proposes a strikingly original packaging design that cannot be manufactured at any realistic cost. How would the lecture classify it?
enOptions: Unusual but not creative, because it is not useful
w04-p13-1.q: 一个团队提出了一个极具原创性的包装设计，但以任何现实的成本都无法生产。课程会如何归类它？
options: 创造性成果（a creative product）
新奇但不具创造性，因为它没有用
创新（an innovation）
正向协同效应（positive synergy）

w04-p13-2.en: A hospital team designs a new patient hand-over checklist, and it is now used on every ward. Which term best describes this outcome?
w04-p13-2.q: 一个医院团队设计了一份新的病人交接清单，现在每个病房都在使用。哪个术语最能描述这一结果？
options: 仅仅是团队创造力（team creativity only）
团队创新（team innovation）
多数无知（pluralistic ignorance）
社会惰化（social loafing）

w04-p13-3.en: A company runs an ideas competition every year, praises the winners, and then nothing happens. Over time employees stop submitting ideas. What does the lecture say is missing?
enOptions: An implementation path that turns creativity into innovation
Larger teams to generate more ideas
A stronger injunctive norm about creativity
w04-p13-3.q: 一家公司每年举办创意比赛，表扬获胜者，然后就没有下文了。久而久之，员工不再提交想法。课程认为缺少的是什么？
options: 员工之间足够的多样性
把创造力转化为创新的实施路径
更大的团队以产生更多想法
关于创造力的更强的指令性规范

w04-p14-0.en: According to Woolley et al. (2010), teams tend to perform better when every member has a chance to speak, and collective intelligence falls when only one or two people talk.
w04-p14-0.q: 根据 Woolley 等人（2010）的研究，当每个成员都有机会发言时，团队往往表现更好；而当只有一两个人发言时，集体智力（collective intelligence）会下降。

w04-p14-1.en: In Team A one person talks and the others agree; in Team C members take roughly equal turns. What does the lecture predict?
enOptions: Team A performs better because decisions are faster
Team C performs better because more members' information enters the discussion
Team A is more creative because it avoids conflict
w04-p14-1.q: A 队一个人说话、其他人附和；C 队的成员大致轮流平等发言。课程会作何预测？
options: A 队表现更好，因为决策更快
C 队表现更好，因为有更多成员的信息进入讨论
两队表现相同
A 队更有创造力，因为它避免了冲突

w04-p14-2.en: Five team members each read out their own idea in turn, and nobody comments on or builds on anyone else's. Why does the lecture say this is not yet team creativity?
enOptions: Ideas are only listed, not challenged, elaborated or combined, so there is no collective information processing
The team lacks an injunctive norm
w04-p14-2.q: 五名团队成员轮流宣读各自的想法，没有人对别人的想法发表评论或在其基础上发展。课程为什么说这还不算团队创造力？
options: 想法太少
想法只是被罗列出来，没有被质疑、深入加工或组合，因此不存在集体信息加工
团队太大
团队缺少指令性规范

w04-p14-3.en: Which manager action best rewards elaboration, as the lecture recommends?
enOptions: Praise the first person to throw out an idea
Praise members who build on and combine other people's ideas
Praise the member who talks most
Praise only ideas that match the manager's own view
w04-p14-3.q: 按照课程的建议，经理的哪种做法最能奖励深入加工（elaboration）？
options: 表扬第一个抛出想法的人
表扬在他人想法基础上发展并加以组合的成员
表扬发言最多的成员
只表扬与经理本人观点一致的想法

w04-p14-4.en: In the lecture's model, sharing information and elaborating on it are the same thing.
